Water software firm Tidewell raises $14 million

Tidewell Software said on Tuesday that it had raised $14 million in a Series A round led by Harrow Lane Partners.

The Austin company, founded in 2016, will use the money to double its engineering team to 40 people.

Its software forecasts street flooding from rain-gauge readings and maps of the drainage network.

Two cities that use the product said it had warned them of overflows during storms in September 2022.

Chief executive Mara Sundqvist said the company expected to become profitable in 2025.

Analysts describe the market for flood-forecasting tools as small but growing quickly.
